**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Meetings
- **Online meeting mode records the other side too.** While a meeting records, the meeting bar has an "Online meeting" / "In person" switch. In Online mode WhisperShortcut captures your Mac's system audio (Teams, Zoom, Meet, …) in addition to your microphone, so remote participants end up in the transcript.
- The first time you switch to Online, macOS asks for "System Audio Recording" permission. If it is blocked, a notice takes you to System Settings.
- Without a headset, your speakers can echo into the microphone. A "No headset detected" hint tells you when that may happen.
- "In person" is the default and behaves exactly as before.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.64...v8.65
